note: Modern campground at William C. Sterling State Park, Michigan's only state park on Lake Erie, a few miles from the Ohio border and about an hour from Detroit; steps from the park's mile of sandy shoreline, with Great Lakes marsh and lagoons. Ten full-amenity cottages. Kayak rentals at the campground office Memorial Day to Labor Day; boating access site with fish-cleaning station at the north end of the park; walleye and perch fishing. Recycling available. --Claude
